body.text: Crypto News Bot — Daily Digest
August 9, 2026
Stablecoin supply has shed roughly $15B since May — the sharpest contraction since Terra's 2022 collapse — even as Circle preps a Sept 16 mainnet launch for its Arc network.
Stablecoin News
Stablecoin supply posts biggest drop since Terra
Total stablecoin supply is down $15B since May, with USDC's circulating supply alone falling ~$1.5B in five weeks to $71.8B as liquidity tightens.
Circle names founding validators for Arc network
Circle announced its founding validator cohort and new institutional integrations for Arc, its blockchain network on track for public mainnet on Sept 16, 2026.
Western Union launches stablecoin-linked Visa card
Western Union's new "Stablecard" pairs a USDPT digital wallet with a Visa card, letting remittances arrive as stablecoins and be spent instantly anywhere Visa is accepted.
CLARITY Act stalls in Senate ahead of recess
Progress on the Digital Asset Market CLARITY Act slowed before the Senate's August recess, prolonging regulatory uncertainty for U.S. stablecoin issuers.
Hacking & Security Incidents
Coldcard hardware wallet exploit grows to ~$130M
A 2021 firmware flaw weakened seed randomness on Coldcard wallets; attackers have drained BTC from over 5,200 addresses across four waves, now the third-largest hack of 2026.
Weak RNG in CryptoJS blamed for $5.7M in wallet drains
A flawed random-number generator in the CryptoJS library left five separate crypto wallet apps exposed, enabling roughly $5.7M in thefts.
BTCPay Server patches critical credential-theft bug
BTCPay Server shipped version 2.4.2 to fix a critical vulnerability that could have let attackers steal LND macaroon credentials and drain Lightning nodes.
Bybit wins injunction freezing Lazarus Group assets
Bybit secured a preliminary U.S. court injunction freezing stolen assets tied to North Korea's Lazarus Group, stemming from the February 2025 $1.5B exchange hack.
